goal: Derive the actual strict first-n complete-history law on the ordered absolute-time simplex, with the product pre-bounce rate/survival density, joint parameter measurability, and every nonnegative extended Borel history test.
source_anchor: Chen-Chewi-Lu-Zhang arXiv2609.06905v1 Appendix A.1 (A.1),(A.2), strict finite-prefix iteration ingredient of (A.7), and Appendix A.2 joint Borel construction; attributed ASTIS completion.
theorem_delta: Derive the actual strict first-n complete-history law on the ordered absolute-time simplex, with the product pre-bounce rate/survival density, joint parameter measurability, and every nonnegative extended Borel history test.
truth_boundary: Six original analytic hypotheses; canonical iid Exp(1) product and literal stopped recursion. Every finite deterministic n and NNReal horizon T, including n=0 and T=0. Simplex 0<t1<...<tn<T carries the subtype comap of finite-dimensional real Lebesgue measure. Density is the finite product of pre-bounce rates times elapsed-segment survivals; no terminal survival. Joint Borel K/q in y,reference,initial phase and simplex time. Pointwise actual/prescribed complete-history identification on the strict prefix event. Exact unnormalized history pushforward, all ENNReal tests and total mass are conclusions, not providers. Abstract A does not constrain record0; actual H0 is live(0,z0). Rank-zero Hilbert and ENNReal tests are explicit ASTIS extensions. This is not the exact-n count event or full A7. Terminal survival, a.e. count/endpoint identification, full path equality, hazard stitching, summability, physical-time restart/Markovness, invariance/hypocoercivity, implementation errors/unbounded costs/main/composition/four papers remain OPEN.
